mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_quiz_info (place_id, title, description, difficulty, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{difficulty}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, TRUE)
INSERT INTO quiz (question, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{question}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, TRUE)
INSERT INTO quiz_answer (content, quiz_id, is_correct) VALUES (#{content}, #{quizId}, #{isCorrect})
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz q JOIN place_quiz pq ON pq.quiz_id = q.quiz_id SET q.is_active = FALSE, q.deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, q.updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE pq.place_quiz_info_id = #{placeQuizInfoId} AND q.is_active = TRUE
